description.value: Garrick's Head is one of the oldest English pubs in Canada, operating continuously in Victoria's historic Bastion Square since 1867 and claiming Vancouver Island's largest selection of craft and import beer on tap. The two-storey pub features a wood-burning fireplace, a 2012-expanded front dining room, and a sunny outdoor patio overlooking the square — a natural rest stop after riding through the Inner Harbour area. Traditional English pub fare and an extensive rotating draught list make it a well-rounded stop for hungry and thirsty touring cyclists.
